Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: In step 7, the WebSurfer agent failed to extract any visible text from the Geni webpage, reporting only metadata and an empty viewport description. Despite this lack of data, the subsequent Planner analysis incorrectly concluded that the page revealed the grandfather's name as "Charles Bretagne Marie de La Trémouille II." The error lies with the WebSurfer for failing to capture the actual content of the page, which led to the hallucinated conclusion in the next step. Historical records confirm the paternal grandfather is Charles Jean Bretagne Godefroy de La Trémoille, not the name generated.
